tagline: Two-panel vertical split, white above and electric blue below, with a blue edge bar and Manrope ExtraBold.

palette.description: white top panel, saturated blue bottom panel, near-black for quote and closing

typography.style: single geometric sans in two weights, titles on the white panel

best_for: Business updates that want a crisp, high-contrast look with generous spacing. The split makes titles and evidence read as two clear layers.
avoid_for: Playful or warm brands, or decks with long paragraphs that need a calm page.
name: Electric Studio
